גַּם is an affirmation particle and לֹא is the only negative. «tampoco … no» negates both slots and can cancel, reversing the prohibition.
H6895 (qal infinitive absolute) and H5344 (qal imperfect) are different lemmas; both are rendered with maldecir, so the lexical distinction is flattened.
Infinitive absolute plus imperfect is smoothed as gerund plus future; the gerund can be read as manner rather than emphatic repetition.
The imperfect is fixed as Spanish future; the morphology does not itself mark future time.
